name: Approvals (veto)
description: Held commands (veto@1): Claude sends a command through Vinnie on axHub, the hub holds it for 3 minutes and then runs it unless you deny it. Notifications when the timer starts, at 30 s left and when it runs (sound + vibration of your choice, each with a test), Deny from the notification, and a Terminal tab per held command with its countdown, Deny and the output.
